 Hurricanes @ Canucks: Preview and Game Thread
 by Bob Wage Oct 20, 2026, 7:53 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 RALEIGH, NORTH CAROLINA - OCTOBER 08: K’andre Miller #19 of the Carolina Hurricanes shoots and scores a goal during the first period of the game against the Vancouver Canucks at Lenovo Center on October 08, 2026 in Raleigh, North Carolina. (Photo by Jared C. Tilton/Getty Images) Getty Images The Carolina Hurricanes (7-2-1) continue their road trip, this time as they take on the Vancouver Canucks (2-7-1) tonight at Rogers Arena. Game time is 10 PM Eastern.
 The Canes are coming off a tough loss in Calgary but they won seven games in a row previous to that game. They also have a few players injured. (Jordan Staal, Taylor Hall, Mark Jankowski, Seth Jarvis).
 The Canucks have lost seven games in a row, including a 7-2 shellacking by these Canes in Raleigh on October 8th.
 The Canes had a morning skate in Vancouver and skated these lines.
 It looks like Vaalimaki will draw in for Reilly. Pyotr Kochetkov will most likely get the start for the Canes in net.
 Jesperi Kotkaniemi has scored in two straight games and will be centering the fourth line once again. His line was probably the best overall on Sunday night. Jordan Martinook will be centering the third line.
 It will be a late one tonight, the recap might not be done until tomorrow morning.
 Watch the contest in the usual manner - Prime Video, Spectrum, Fubo. Listen online at 99.9 The Fan.
